export const meta = {
  name: 'hail-b2-round4-completion',
  description: 'B2 round four: the cross-owner completion list and decisions D30 to D32 (zone event key, upgrades end the lower event, failed station or zone files in the browser, cancelled-at wording parity), three fixers by ownership, then a re-check',
  phases: [
    { title: 'Fix', detail: 'joins and contract; browser and tests; docs and record' },
    { title: 'Recheck', detail: 'tests, parity, smoke, store verify, record' },
  ],
}
const WT = '/home/user/wt/wt-b2'
const BRIEF = '/home/user/wt/briefs/hail-b2-brief.md'
const OUT = '/home/user/hail-b2/out2'
const STORE_DIR = '/home/user/hail-b1/out2/store/store'
const VENV = '/home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python'
const COMMON = `You work in the git worktree ${WT} (branch claude/hail-b2). Read ${BRIEF} in full first, especially the sections "Supervisor decisions after review round 1", "round 2" (D15 to D24), "round 3" (D25 to D29) and "round 3 ... D30 to D32 and the completion list" at the end: D30 to D32 override anything earlier that they name (D25's issue-time sentence and D27 are withdrawn). Repository rules (AGENTS.md is in your context): Python first, evidence honesty, feed contracts changed with the parser and the tests together, plain wording in sentence case, no em-dashes, no model, AI-vendor or AI-product names in repository files, tests with every behaviour change. Other fixers edit other files in this worktree now: edit only the files you own, never run git checkout, stash, reset, add, commit or push, never reformat a file you do not own, and never delete anything outside a folder you created under ${OUT}/<your-name>/ (tests delete only folders they created). A python with pyarrow, numpy and pyshp is ${VENV}; the B1 store is at ${STORE_DIR}; the joins cache is at ${OUT}/joins/cache (or /home/user/hail-b2/out/joins/cache). Network is available. Return a plain report: what you changed (file and line), the commands you ran with their tails, and anything not done.`
const JOINS = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the joins fixer; you own website/joins.py, tests/test_joins.py and, for this run only, the CONTRACTS row nws_zone_products in website/sources.py. Do completion-list item 2: (a) D31: revert the data-4 change at joins.py line about 1892 so an UPG row ends its event at the upgrade time exactly as a CAN row does (treat UPG like CAN for the end; remember which status produced the end so the words can say "upgraded" or "cancelled"); add WORDS_JOINS key zones_upgraded (", upgraded") parallel to zones_cancelled and use it in _zone_event_text (and the "cancelled at {time}" rule of D26 applies to an upgrade at or before the begin as "upgraded at {time}"); update the two data-4 tests and add one for an UPG-ended event; (b) D30: confirm the group key (zone, phenomenon, significance, wfo, event number, year) is the existing behaviour and write it into the _zone_events docstring with the known limit (one span when an event number is re-used for separate periods; four zones in five years); (c) the sources.py row nws_zone_products: the end is the earliest cancellation or upgrade time, else the latest expiry, "end not recorded" only when none exists; the key sentence; (d) run ${VENV} -m unittest tests.test_joins tests.test_site tests.test_hail (tail), then rebuild the store: copy ${STORE_DIR} to ${OUT}/joins/store-r4, run python -m website.joins build --store ${OUT}/joins/store-r4 --cache <the cache> --procs 4, verify, compare, tar as ${OUT}/joins/hail-store.tar.gz (replace the old tar only after verify passes; keep a copy of the old one as hail-store.tar.gz.r3) and report the index counts (zone_events, unplaced, ends by kind) before and after.`
const SITE = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the browser fixer; you own website/static/map/map.js, website/static/map/map.css, tests/test_site.py and tools/smoke_map.py. Do completion-list item 1 with its clarification: (a) the failing test tests/test_site.py test_a_station_file_that_did_not_load_says_so_and_gives_no_count: find why stationLost does not trigger under the node harness (the harness may resolve a missing file where Chromium's fetch rejects; or hailTile may accept a non-object document) and fix whichever side departs from the browser, so a station or zone file that fails to load gives its section the unavailable sentence and nothing else (D28); (b) D26 and D31 wording parity: a cancelled event whose cancellation time is at or before its begin reads "cancelled at {time}" exactly as Python's _zone_event_text does, and an upgraded event reads its span with the zones_upgraded word (read website/joins.py's _zone_event_text and WORDS_JOINS after the joins fixer's change lands: poll every 2 minutes up to 30 minutes for zones_upgraded to appear; the browser takes the words from map.json, never literals); (c) the parity test case in tests/test_site.py for a cancelled-before-begin event and an upgraded event (build the fixture rows in the test); (d) keep the smoke exact comparison passing: build the real store site when ${OUT}/joins/hail-store.tar.gz is refreshed by the joins fixer (poll; else the current tar) into ${OUT}/site-r4/real with --hail-history --sample --hail-store, run PW_CHROMIUM=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium ${VENV} tools/smoke_map.py on it and quote the result; run ${VENV} -m unittest tests.test_site (tail). No literal sentence, unit, radius or threshold in map.js.`
const DOCS = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the docs fixer; you own docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/DESIGN.md, docs/ROADMAP.md and research/hail-history/validation-evidence/b2-verification.json. Do completion-list item 3: (a) DECISIONS D35: the zone event key per D30 (one VTEC event per zone, phenomenon, significance, event number and year; updates with other issue times belong to it; the known limit of a re-used event number, four zones in five years, as an open item), the upgrade rule per D31 (an UPG row ends the lower event at the upgrade time, citing NWS Instruction 10-1703; the span reads "upgraded"), the withdrawals named (the issue-time sentence of D25; D27); line 769 and open items 11 and 12 wording consistent with D30 and D31; the "cancelled at {time}" rule of D26 stated once; (b) b2-verification.json: the data-6 figures (110 zone groups with a NEW row, 157 NEW rows), the D30 open item, and a note of round 4 (D30 to D32) under notes; (c) DESIGN section 9: the zones section's words include "upgraded" beside "cancelled"; (d) em-dashes 0, no model or AI-vendor names, sentence case; report the diff stat.`
phase('Fix')
const fixes = await parallel([
  () => agent(JOINS, { label: 'fix4:joins', phase: 'Fix', model: 'haiku' }),
  () => agent(SITE, { label: 'fix4:site', phase: 'Fix', model: 'haiku' }),
  () => agent(DOCS, { label: 'fix4:docs', phase: 'Fix', model: 'haiku' }),
])
log(`fixers done: ${fixes.map((f) => (f ? 'ok' : 'null')).join(', ')}`)
phase('Recheck')
const recheck = await agent(`Read-only final checker in ${WT} (branch claude/hail-b2). Read ${BRIEF} (all decision sections, D1 to D32, and the completion list). Never edit, stage, commit or push, except the one file named below; scratch only under ${OUT}/recheck4/ which you create. Run and quote: ${VENV} -m unittest discover -s tests (tail; every test must pass); python desktop/launcher.py --selftest payload; builds from a copy of the worktree (cp -r without .git into ${OUT}/recheck4/src): --sample --now 2026-10-18T12:00:00Z into ${OUT}/recheck4/off, --hail-history --sample into ${OUT}/recheck4/sample, --hail-history --sample --hail-store ${OUT}/joins/hail-store.tar.gz into ${OUT}/recheck4/real; the base identity: git -C ${WT} archive 7aec754 | tar -x -C ${OUT}/recheck4/base-src, its flag-off build, diff -rq against off (only static/map/map.js, static/map/map.css and ?v= lines may differ); PW_CHROMIUM=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium ${VENV} tools/smoke_map.py on each build (--shots on the real one) and tools/smoke_pages.py on the real one; the exact browser-to-Python comparison the smoke runs; python -m website.joins verify and compare on the store the tar came from (${OUT}/joins/store-r4 if present, else ${OUT}/joins/store); the index counts (zone events, unplaced, ends by cancellation, upgrade, expiry, none) and the number of "upgraded" and "cancelled at" spans in the gate zone MTZ313 and over the store; du -sb of hail/j, hail/z, hail/s; git -C ${WT} status --short and diff --stat 7aec754; em-dash and banned-name counts over added lines; a grep of the built real pages for an unfilled brace inside hail sections; the decision 7 audit (every rmtree, unlink or os.remove under tests/ acts on a folder the test created). Then update research/hail-history/validation-evidence/b2-verification.json in ${WT} (the one file you may edit): gates B2-1 to B2-9 with status and evidence (B2-1 per D1, two cells; B2-4 deferred as agreed), the measurements, and under notes the round-4 items done. Return the gate table and measurements as JSON text, and name every test or check that failed.`, { label: 'recheck4', phase: 'Recheck', model: 'haiku' })
return { fixes: fixes.map((f) => (f || '').slice(0, 6000)), recheck }

4. The stations partial sentence was skipped when no station was in range. It now matches Python.
5. Any exception while filling sections gives all six sections the unavailable sentence (the town-page fallback). `joinSections` never rejects silently.
6. In the node harness, `json()` threw synchronously on a bad body instead of rejecting like `Response.json()`. Fixed in `tests/test_site.py` line 2132. A missing file is a 404 response with `ok` false in both Chromium and the harness, and `hailTile` rejects in both.
